answer: A courier commits a hash of the manifest before pickup and reveals it after drop-off with a fresh nonce each run, so a copied receipt cannot be replayed. Because the receipt is split into three slices held by auditors who never see each other's slice, faking one delivery means forging three consistent stories, and a farm that reuses one template melts like a glacier under the first mismatch, burning a plume of fresh nonces and proxies for more than the willow of real runs returns.
